hooks.name: Python syntax check on save
hooks.description: Compiles a saved backend Python file to catch syntax errors immediately. Read-only; deploys nothing.

action.command: f=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get("file_path") or d.get("path") or d.get("filePath") or "")' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] && python3 -m py_compile "$f" && echo "syntax ok: $f"; true
